limits: No random-number generation or all-seed proof.
Authored CTB event schedule; mitigation, damage, wear, bleeding, duration-to-energy checked; arbitrary CTB choices/control scheduling not simulated.
No production imports, persistence, UI, schemas, engine, npm tests or player experience testing.
Fixed source subset only; no claimed randomized hospital bonus pickups.
Geometry is one deterministic constructive witness per step, not all packings; no physical auto-sort UI is authorized.
Four full five-map routes; three specialties, optional bypass/shortcut, other risk trees and thirty-day economy not covered.
Final terminal cases are independent fixtures, not complete action prefixes; terminal penalties/recall remain OPTION awaiting Owner.
Failed parameter variants mean the same authored plan needs replanning, not the entire world is unsolvable.
Injury movement multipliers, bruises and general injury stacking are not modeled; route inputs have no movement-modifying bruise.
The entirely empty character continuation checks only one authored next-task movement arithmetically; it is not an implemented next-task world or proof of a survival solution.
